question: Which of the following god/goddess is NOT associated with Ratha Yatra festival of Puri, Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Shiva**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratha Yatra** is a major festival celebrated in **Puri, Odisha, dedicated to Lord Jagannath, **his brother Lord Balabhadra, and their sister Devi Subhadra.
 
• **Lord Jagannath **is considered the main deity of the Ratha Yatra festival, and the festival is also known as the "Festival of Chariots" as the deities are taken out in grand chariots for a procession.
 
• Lord Balabhadra is the elder brother of Lord Jagannath and is also worshipped in Puri. Devi Subhadra is the younger sister of Lord Jagannath and is also worshipped during the Ratha Yatra festival.
 
• Lord Shiva is not associated with the Ratha Yatra festival of Puri, Odisha, although he is worshipped in other parts of India and is considered one of the major Hindu deities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Lord Jagannath is a form of Lord Vishnu and is worshipped as the Lord of the Universe. He is also known as the "Lord of the World" and is considered the presiding deity of the city of Puri.
 
• Lord Balabhadra is the elder brother of Lord Jagannath and is worshipped as a form of Lord Vishnu. He is also known as Balarama and is considered the source of all spiritual strength and power.
 
• Devi Subhadra is the younger sister of Lord Jagannath and is worshipped as a form of Goddess Durga. She is also known as Subhadra Devi and is considered the embodiment of love and compassion.
 
• Lord Shiva is one of the major Hindu deities and is worshipped as the destroyer of evil and the transformer of the universe. He is also known as Mahadeva, Nataraja, and Rudra, among other names.
